author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Add repeatable N01–N05 software failure campaign and sanitized evidence
details: Fixed 25-case campaign combines multi-stage consumer/policy failures with accepted native TLS, replay/clock, bounded flood/inference and watchdog tests. Reports preserve case outcomes, allowlisted metrics and source hashes without payloads/credentials. Software-only results cannot establish real-device/physical acceptance.
validation: All 25 selected cases passed in each Windows/Linux campaign, no skips/errors/failures, and all 92 shared checks passed on both. Added ten fast campaign/report tests under existing discovery. No production modules, protected workflow, Pi/camera/GPIO or deployed services changed.
